title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence Marking for English Subject Assignments on Students' Creativity and Writing Ability
what_it_is: Impact of Artificial Intelligence Marking for English Subject Assignments on Students' Creativity and Writing Ability

sections.label: Educational technology complements teachers' role
sections.summary: Educational technology aims to complement, not dilute, teachers' central role, with the Learning Feedback Assistant for English Language giving students personalised feedback on spelling and grammar.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our use of educational technology aims to complement and not dilute our teachers' central role in guiding students to learn and master different subjects, especially for higher-level skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For instance, the Learning Feedback Assistant for English Language (LFA(EL)) provides personalised feedback directly to students on areas such as spelling and grammar.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Teachers can then focus their attention to guide students on more complex aspects of language construction and to develop higher-level skills like creative expression, persuasiveness and tone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For students, immediate feedback from the LFA(EL) can also encourage them to write more often, be more self-directed in their learning and to work on their basic writing errors.
